findings.problem: Correct and complete, but 64 cells — 17 more than EN — so the picker's ellipsized description column crops its tail before EN's does. Measured on the real widget: at a 100/110-column terminal (picker width 73, description budget 56) the row paints 'Voir ou régler le mode d’approbation des outils de cett…'; EN at the same width paints whole. Both verbs and the object ('des outils') survive every width measured, and /help wraps (overflow='fold') rather than cutting, so the claim a user needs is never lost — only the final word, at widths where EN loses nothing.
